description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Soulstinger.
When Soulstinger dies, its undying ability and second ability trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, optionally putting -1/-1 counter(s) on another creature.
Resolve the Soulstinger trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Soulstinger enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.
